wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.855 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 8.67% cost of equity. Beta is Damodaran Retail (Grocery and Food) cash-corrected unlevered 0.848 relevered at Costco D/E of about 0.01 (debt 6.2B vs large market cap; my estimate). Debt weight is negligible, so WACC is about 8.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal US GDP growth; a conservative rate for a still-expanding retailer.

transcript.content:
Tools: the deskstack data tools (SEC and EU ESEF filings, rates, Damodaran inputs). Use them for every filed figure.

Build a quick unlevered DCF for Costco Wholesale Corporation (identifier: COST).
- History: revenue, operating income (EBIT), D&A and capex for the last three filed fiscal years.
- Five projected years with your assumptions: revenue growth per year, EBIT margin, tax rate, D&A and capex as % of
  revenue, WACC and terminal growth, each with its rationale as the source.
- Bridge: net debt and diluted shares at the last fiscal year end (shares in the same scale as the money figures).
Submit it with submit_model, kind "dcf".
